18 PhD positions available at the Faculty of Science
Start
/News
As a PhD student at Stockholm University, you will have the opportunity to deepen your knowledge within a research field and contribute to new knowledge. The Faculty of Science is now offering 18 PhD positions across a range of scientific disciplines.
For a full list of available PhD positions in English, please visit Available jobs.
Research at the Department of Chemistry. Photo: Simon Hastegård
